title: Board & Card Games Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=bgg:play) OR (index=personal sourcetype=pokernow:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="bgg:play","primary",sourcetype="pokernow:session","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from bgg:play and pokernow:session to see whether two board feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `bgg:play` and `pokernow:session` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main board data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
